venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Thursday 10/15 (MOD MKZ/JK, entered by Daniel).** Net sales $1,558 vs target $1,606 (-3%). Food $363. 54 guests, $28.85 check avg. Comps $88.45. Strong start; Halloween cocktail specials (zombie) a hit. Lull around 7, busy 8:30-10pm with football fans watching Seahawks/Broncos. Last call 11:30, out by midnight. Busiest Thursday in a while. No incidents.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Thursday 10/15 (MOD MD / Chef JMS, entered by BC).** Net sales $3,973 vs target $2,657 (+50%). Food $101; event sales $2,471. 77 guests, $51.60 check avg. Comps $17.10 (0.4%): F&F, industry, employee. Slow-paced Thursday until a late birthday party arrived just before 10pm (>100 guests, tab extended several times); fake IDs turned away at the door; party ended near midnight. Industry guests in last hour. 86: draft Guinness, Pumpkin Cream Ale; low candied ginger, Pet Nat Paloma. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Thursday 10/15 (MOD Marcus / Meghan).** Net sales incl. events $4,861.76 vs target $4,350 (+12%). Marquee bar $1,743; food $664.80. 133 guests (88 walk-in, 45 reso); check avg recorded as net/guests $36.55 (form GCA $40.18 / CA $87.81). Comps $380.82 incl. investor walk-out $141.66 (under follow-up), DNL $22, gift $22, wrong item $93. Prep and host out sick; plumbers removed garbage disposal, opening pushed to 6pm. Full by 7, waitlist before 8, full until ~10. Dish backed up during plumbing work. Maintenance: curtain, water heater. No incidents.

Final cocktail presentations for new menu. 86: finger limes (back 10/17). No incidents.
